inhomogeneous_deformation.description: Inhomogeneous deformation of C(n+1) induced by the mixed pre-oscillator form (b_j^s | a_1^σ) = -gb_{σ,j,s}; brackets computed in U(A) and split by κ.
inhomogeneous_deformation.bracket_convention: [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ γ(X,Y), κ written on the left; [X,Y] graded commutator

gb_matrix.parity_note: Formal parity label from C_inhomogeneous_definition.md (gb multiplies the odd κ in an odd-even mixed bracket). For computation gb are commuting scalars: the odd degree is carried by κ alone, otherwise [b,a] (odd) = -gb κ would be even.

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_target_space: g ⊕ C K; an entry with Z = 'K' is the central part (coefficient of κK = κ)
inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_parity_rule: p(Z) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 mod 2 (κ is odd); K counts as even
inhomogeneous_deformation.symmetry: γ(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} γ(X,Y); all ordered pairs are stored
inhomogeneous_deformation.linearity: γ is exactly linear in gb (κ^2 = 0); coeff maps gb symbol -> rational
